newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 18.184 bln levs 1-, 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 18.184 bln levs 1-, 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry sold 18.184 billion levs of one-week and four-week discount T-bills, yielding 1.37 and 5.61 percent until maturity, respectively, central bank figures showed.
Bids were received for a total of 24.287 billion levs of T-bills for Thursday's auctions but the ministry approved bids for 18.184 billion levs.
The issues were offered with par values of 20 billion levs and 45 billion levs, respectively and no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 20,000 million levs 45,000 million levs
Bids received 11,668.4 million levs 12,618.8 million levs
Bids approved 8,415.4 million levs 9,768.8 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 1.37 pct 5.61 pct
